Tesla Roadster Demonstrates Mid-Air Maneuvers with SpaceX Thrusters

Tesla has unveiled its new Roadster, which demonstrated mid-air maneuvers, including turning and flipping, utilizing SpaceX thrusters. The car was shown driving on the road before taking flight and performing stunts, with a safe landing depicted. Elon Musk shared a video of these capabilities. Production for the Roadster is slated for 2028, with an initial price of at least $200,000 for the 2026 model. One report suggested the flying Roadster could be a tool in the competition for talent.
